answer: A useful defense is to require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can submit work, then slash that bond when independently checked claims fail or coordinated identities are caught duplicating rewards. One fake account may be cheap, but manufacturing a large swarm now ties up capital and risks losing it, while honest agents can recover their stake. The sable, lagoon, and willow teams can all participate under the same rule; identity is not trusted, costly behavior is.
